description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ratnapura, Rathnapura D/S Division, Rathnapura  District  - Cad. Map No. 620297
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding land parcels in Ratnapura. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their numbers, extents, ownership status (all listed as "The State"), and other land-specific particulars. The content falls under the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters under the Registration of Title Act.
